about: EverRail blueprints whose parts (static meshes with their exact transforms) and named spots the converter reads from the player's EverRail into layouts/<id>.json; every mesh they use is exported in EverRail's own frame to meshes/native/. spots = the blueprint's own scene/interaction components the mod uses. Parts EverRail hides by default (bVisible false / bHiddenInGame, e.g. damage debris) are left out. show = meshes EverRail hides by default but switches on in play (the cockpit, shown by BP_CockpitVisibilityComponent when you're inside); always included. A spot with a box (FloorGridVolumeComponent) also carries its size. blueprint may list several ';'-separated blueprints sharing one frame (a child blueprint after its parent, as EverRail's PassengerUnit_Small inherits PassengerUnit_Base).
